subject: load table on request via search box

messages.author: 4007d4b2c6547b05
messages.subject: load table on request via search box
parts:
I'm using shinydashboard and I have a table on a database that is big and I can't load it all once the Shiny dashboard is loaded because it makes the dashboard very slow.


The workaround would be to show only the info when requested.


So I'll have a search box that once you search for person's name, it will load all info related to this person.


Here is a toy example:



library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

header <- dashboardHeader()
sidebar <- dashboardSidebar(sidebarMenu(menuItem(
  "xxx", tabName = "zz")))

body <- dashboardBody(
  tabItems(
    tabItem(selected = TRUE, tabName = "zz",
            navbarPage(
              title = 'zz',
              tabPanel(
                'Customer',
                DT::dataTableOutput('cars')
              )
            )
    )))

ui <- dashboardPage(header, sidebar, body)

server <- function(input, output) {
  ctdata <-  mtcars
  output$cars <- DT::renderDataTable({
    DT::datatable(
      ctdata,
      rownames = FALSE,
      extensions = 'Buttons',
      plugins = 'searchHighlight',
      options = list(
        dom = 'Bfrtip',
        buttons = I('colvis'),
        pageLength = 25)
    )
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)

So, here is what I'd like:

1) This table should not pre-loaded. It will only load once I go to the search box and search for something.

2) I want my search box to only accept values in the variable "mpg"

messages.subject: Re: load table on request via search box
parts: Hiya! The following are your friends in this situation: req, actionButton, observe, and isolate. (Links are to the various Shiny articles on those topics.) Here's how one possible solution:

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

header <- dashboardHeader()
sidebar <- dashboardSidebar(sidebarMenu(menuItem(
  "xxx", tabName = "zz")))

body <- dashboardBody(
  tabItems(
    tabItem(selected = TRUE, tabName = "zz",
            navbarPage(
              title = 'zz',
              tabPanel(
                'Customer',

fluidRow(
                  column(textInput("customer", "Customer", placeholder = "setosa, versicolor, or virginica"), width = 6),
                  column(actionButton("query_btn", "Query"), width = 6)
                ),
                DT::dataTableOutput('iris')

)
            )
    )))

ui <- dashboardPage(header, sidebar, body)

server <- function(input, output) {

ctdata <- reactiveVal(NULL) # initialize
  
  observe({
    # react when user queries using the button, which starts at 0
    if (input$query_btn > 0) {
      # isolate() prevents reaction when input$customer changes
      isolate({
        # this is where you could include your database-querying code
        ctdata(iris[iris$Species == input$customer, ])
      })
    }
  })
  
  output$iris <- DT::renderDataTable({
    # req() ensures that we have data before we try to display it
    req(ctdata())
    DT::datatable(
      ctdata(),

rownames = FALSE,
      extensions = 'Buttons',
      plugins = 'searchHighlight',
      options = list(
        dom = 'Bfrtip',
        buttons = I('colvis'),
        pageLength = 25)
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
